text: どうぐには　まちや　みちで　つかうもの　たたかいの　ときにのみ　つかえるもの。

structure.jp: まちや　みちで　つかうもの
structure.en: ones you use in towns and on roads

structure.jp: たたかいの　ときにのみ　つかえるもの。
structure.en: ones you can use only during battle

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed right before a thing describes that thing. まちや みちで つかうもの = 'things you use in towns and on roads'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing つかう to つかえる turns 'use' into 'can use'. つかえるもの = 'things you can use'.
